risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and well quantified regarding sales, margins, geographic performance, and cost drivers, with an overall confident operating tone. Risk is concentrated in market cyclicality, supply-chain and geopolitical factors, customer/order execution, geographic weakness in China and Latin America, and uncertainty around future forecasts. Some extensive forward-looking disclaimers and dense explanations of cost reallocation reduce clarity but do not appear materially evasive.
